ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 Revision, effective 1 January 2025); People's Bank of China and State Administration for Market Regulation Order No. 3 [2024] 'Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information' (effective 1 November 2024); SAMR Provisions on the Registration Administration of Market Entities (2021, Order No. 13); Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024); Regulations on the Implementation of the Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (State Council Decree No. 723)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry / Registrar of Companies in the foreign investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille pathway (if home state is a 1961 Hague Apostille Convention member): the Certificate must be apostilled by the competent authority in the home state and is then acceptable for Chinese WFOE filing without any consular legalization. Consular legalization pathway (if home state is not an Apostille Convention member): the Certificate must be notarized in the home state and then legalized by the Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China. These two routes are parallel and mutually exclusive and shall never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Existence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of Commerce / Companies House / Official corporate registry in the foreign investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille pathway (if home state is a member): the Certificate is apostilled by the competent authority, then submitted directly to SAMR. Consular legalization pathway (if home state is a non-member): notarization in the home state, followed by consular legalization at the PRC Embassy or Consulate. Never apply both; the two routes are mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney authorizing incorporation of the CN WFOE and appointing its Legal Representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the foreign investor company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The resolution is signed by directors, notarized by a licensed notary public in the home state, then authenticated exclusively by either (i) the Hague Apostille certificate issued by the competent authority if the home state is a member, or (ii) consular legalization by the PRC Embassy/Consulate if the home state is a non-member. Apostille and consular legalization are alternative and mutually exclusive; they cannot follow each other.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum of Association of the Foreign Investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry where the foreign investor is incorporated (certified copy) or notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: A certified copy is obtained from the registry or a notary in the home state, then either (i) a Hague Apostille is issued by the home state's competent authority, or (ii) consular legalization is performed by the PRC Embassy/Consulate for non-member states. The two authentication paths are separate and exclusive; no sequential chain is permitted.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from the Investor's Principal Bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank maintaining the investor's corporate account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: The reference letter must be signed by an authorized bank officer and notarized in the home state, then subjected to only one of the following: Hague Apostille by the competent authority for member states or consular legalization by the PRC Embassy/Consulate for non-member states. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive and must never be performed sequentially on a single instrument.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, senior managers, customs agents and any shareholder exceeding 10% economic exposure against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, and the domestic AML/CFT lists maintained by the PBOC Anti-Money Laundering Monitoring and Analysis Center, including China's suspicious transaction list and tax or debt enforcement blacklists. Before incorporating the CN_WFOE_LTD, the responsible partner must obtain a negative match report for each covered individual and entity, update the search every 72 hours until incorporation, and require a notarized declaration as to the absence of PEP affiliation with domestic or foreign political bodies, unless a higher-risk relationship is approved by the AML compliance officer under enhanced due diligence.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Name Reservation and Registration System of the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Chinese enterprise name must be in simplified Chinese characters only and must consist of four tiers: administrative division, a distinctive trade name of two or more Chinese characters which may be a phonetic transliteration of the foreign investor's corporate name into pinyin, an industry or trade expression such as International Freight Transportation or Customs Bonded Logistics, and a legal form suffix such as Co., Ltd. or Limited Liability Company. The Latin-script investor name must be transliterated phonetically into simplified Chinese characters; identical or confusingly similar names already registered by other enterprises in the same industry are rejected. All official English references in the corporate records must match the approved Chinese name through the standard pinyin transcription doctrine of the SAMR.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon receiving a formal rejection, the filer has 7 days to file an online ground of review using the same SAMR name-application reference number, to which the name-review section must respond within 3 working days. If the rejection is upheld, the applicant may request administrative reconsideration from the municipal or provincial SAMR within 60 days of the rejection decision, presenting a corrected name and the original rejection memo. Alternatively, the applicant may directly institute an administrative suit at the competent local people's court within 6 months from the date of notification. The appeal must set out the legal grounds, alternative names, and supporting argument that the desired name is not identical or misleading in the relevant industry.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For this customs bonded trucking WFOE (ISIC 5222/NAICS 484121), a virtual office or commercial mailbox is categorically rejected. The SAMR requires the registered office to be a physical premises in mainland China, with lease or ownership evidence. Municipal tax authorities require the registered address to be the place where statutory books, accounting vouchers and invoices are physically kept. The China General Administration of Customs (GACC) requires applicants for operation as a customs bonded road carrier to maintain a registered place of business, a parking facility for the GPS-sealed bonded fleet, and records of bonded small-package transport. Banks under PBOC AML/KYC circulars demand on-site inspections and face-to-face verification of the beneficial owners before opening a corporate account. A commercial mailbox defeats these physical inspection, record retention and anti-money-laundering requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for inspection readiness: (1) display the business license in the registered office; (2) verify a physical floor directory and reception function; (3) keep statutory books and tax vouchers on site; (4) maintain a listed business telephone and email alias; (5) store vehicle GPS log records and customs bonded movement manifests; (6) ensure the lease is under the WFOE name and the rental has office furniture consistent with substantive operations. Quantified risk: high — 65-80% probability that the municipal SAMR, tax bureau or GACC will make an unannounced physical presence inspection within the first 12 months after incorporation for a new bonded freight entity, with roughly 35% probability of a second inspection in the following year.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SAMR company name clearance and incorporation application filing (including UBO declaration under PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (municipal branch)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory incorporation or filing fee is charged in China since 2017; the government filing is free of charge.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Physical registered office lease - first year rent and management fee for a 30-square-meter office in a Customs Supervised Area or Free Trade Zone such as Shanghai Lingang
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for serviced or Grade A offices in the free trade zone, approximately USD 1,200 to 1,500 per month plus management fee.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO, PEP and sanctions screening, enhanced due diligence and beneficial ownership chart preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External compliance consultancy or retained Chinese law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate of USD 500 per hour for managed EDD research, estimated 6 hours; or fixed package of USD 2,500 to 3,500 for a Chinese-law-governed WFOE.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and authentication of the foreign investor's corporate documents via Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization pathway in accordance with authentication rules
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in the home jurisdiction; competent apostille authority; Embassy or Consulate of the People's Republic of China
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular legalization fee of USD 100 to 200 per page plus notary fees; block package for five instruments typically USD 2,200 to 3,500.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation and translation of WFOE constitutional documents (Articles of Association, shareholders resolution, legal representative appointment, UBO filing) and submission to SAMR
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Chinese law firm or incorporated company secretary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed professional fee for WFOE formation under Shanghai market benchmark of RMB 20,000 to 35,000 translated at indicative USD 2,800 to 4,800.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation feasibility consultation for road freight transport license and customs bonded carrier registration under GACC supervision rules
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Chinese licensed agency for road transport permits and customs affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing consultancy fee for ISIC 5222 license eligibility assessment and application outline: USD 3,000 to 4,500 fixed.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Sections governing company name and domicile (Articles 8-10), establishment of limited liability companies (Articles 23-37), registered capital and contribution obligations (Articles 45-53), corporate governance and mandatory officers (Articles 68-83); Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2020), Articles 4 and 30; Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Registration Administration of Companies; Foreign Investment Negative List (2024 Edition).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the local Market Regulation Administration of the district or city in which the registered office is located, acting through the National Enterprise Registration Online Service and the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Foreign-Invested Company Establishment Registration Application Form submitted together with the Articles of Association, the registered office domicile declaration, legal representative appointment and shareholder qualification evidence under the SAMR online establishment module.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The Company Law of the People's Republic of China does not impose a statutory minimum registered capital for an ordinary wholly foreign-owned enterprise limited liability company. The sole shareholder must state the subscribed capital in the Articles of Association and contribute that capital in full within five years from the date of establishment for companies registered after 1 July 2024. No blocked escrow account or proof of paid-up capital is required at the time of company incorporation. However, for the customs bonded truck fleet sector, the road transport regulator and the customs authority may, during the subsequent sectoral licensing phase, assess whether the registered capital and available funds are sufficient to cover the planned fleet size, customs bond obligations, insurance and safety liabilities.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] WFOE LIMITED. This resolution is made unanimously by the board of directors, or by the sole executive director acting with sole shareholder consent where the company has not established a board, at a duly convened meeting and in accordance with the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Articles of Association. 1. RESOLVED, that the establishment of the company as a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company engaged in GPS-sealed customs-bonded road feeder truck services for international airports is approved; the registered capital of the company shall be as stated in the Articles of Association, fully subscribed by the sole shareholder and contributed within the statutory period. 2. RESOLVED, that all registration applications, articles, declarations, legalization documents and auxiliary forms submitted or to be submitted to the State Administration for Market Regulation are ratified and confirmed, and the legal representative is authorized to execute and file all amendments and supplemental instruments. 3. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the company is fixed at [address], and the legal representative or any authorized director is directed to procure the lease, adopt the domicile and register such address with the company registry and tax authorities. 4. RESOLVED, that the following statutory officers are appointed with immediate effect: legal representative [name], executive director or general manager [name], and supervisor [name], provided that the supervisor does not concurrently hold the position of legal representative or manager and that all appointments comply with the Articles and applicable disqualification rules. 5. RESOLVED, that the company shall maintain proper accounting books, tax files and statutory corporate records at the registered office and shall engage a certified public accountant for statutory audits when required by law. 6. RESOLVED, that the company shall open banking accounts including the basic RMB deposit account and foreign currency capital account with a licensed commercial bank, and that any two authorized signatories among the legal representative, the finance officer and the corporate seal keeper, acting with the company seal, may execute banking resolutions, wire instructions and signatory mandates. 7. RESOLVED, that management is authorized to obtain all required road transport permits, customs supervised vehicle registrations, environmental registrations, fire safety approvals and airport access authorizations, and to engage licensed external professionals as necessary. 8. RESOLVED, that all lawful acts done by promoters, directors and duly appointed agents on behalf of the company before the date of this resolution are ratified and confirmed. This resolution shall be effective until rescinded or amended by a later board resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legalization of foreign investor identity, name pre-approval and foreign investment negative list screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation through the National Enterprise Name Registration System and the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform; local government service center under SAMR.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify that the proposed corporate name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name using the SAMR name pre-approval module. If the shareholder is a foreign legal person, its certificate of incorporation, constitutional documents and board authorization must be apostilled under the Hague Apostille Convention dated 7 November 2023, or legalized by a Chinese embassy or consulate where apostille is unavailable, and translated into Chinese by a qualified translation service. Confirm that the proposed customs bonded road feeder trucking business is outside the Foreign Investment Negative List and is therefore eligible for national treatment. Submit the name application and the foreign investment compliance memorandum, and obtain the provisional name approval before proceeding to establishment filing.
required_dossiers: Completed Application for Name Pre-approval
Apostilled or legalized certificate of incorporation of the foreign corporate shareholder
Chinese translation of all foreign language corporate documents
Power of attorney or board resolution appointing the Chinese contact
Passport or national identity copy of the proposed legal representative
Proposed Articles of Association and foreign investment access opinion
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected on similarity grounds, revise the name with additional distinctive elements and re-file immediately. If the negative list screening raises doubt, submit a supplemental legal opinion and explanatory memorandum to the responsible commerce or SAMR office. Any official query must be answered within fifteen working days; failure to respond may cause the application to be closed without prejudice to a new application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of establishment registration and issuance of the business license
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Regulation Administration under the State Administration for Market Regulation, through the National Enterprise Registration Online Service and the local one-stop government service portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Foreign-Invested Company Establishment Registration Application Form in the online portal and upload the executed Articles of Association, the apostilled shareholder identity documents, the legal representative declaration, proof of the registered office lease and property ownership certificate, and all auxiliary forms. No official state filing fee is payable. The registry reviews the filings, issues the unified social credit code, and issues the business license. The company must not commence bonded road freight operations on the strength of the business license alone; all sectoral permissions from the transport authority and customs must be separately obtained. The business license is the foundational document required for seal engraving, tax registration, bank account opening and customs registration.
required_dossiers: Foreign-Invested Company Establishment Registration Application Form
Original and notarized Articles of Association
Apostilled or legalized shareholder identity and authorization documents
Registered office lease agreement and property ownership certificate or landlord consent
Legal representative appointment form, ID copy and specimen signature
Supervisor appointment form and consent
SAMR name pre-approval notice
Foreign Investment Negative List non-applicability memorandum
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a rectification notice, correct the stated defects within the statutory fifteen-day correction period and resubmit electronically. If the application is rejected on foreign investment access grounds, request a written rejection decision and pursue administrative reconsideration or judicial review within the applicable limitation period. If the defect is limited to translation or notarization, replace the defective documentation and resubmit without additional state fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company seal engraving, tax registration, social insurance registration and statistical filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-designated seal engraving enterprise; State Taxation Administration electronic tax bureau; local human resources and social security authority; statistical registration desk.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the business license, the legal representative or authorized agent must apply at an approved seal engraving enterprise for the company official seal, finance seal, legal representative seal and contract seal. The engraving enterprise files the seal specimens with the public security organ. The company must then register its tax status with the electronic tax bureau, obtain the taxpayer identification and reporting profile, and complete social insurance and payroll enrollment for any staff. Statistical registration and the enterprise information public disclosure filing are also completed. This step is mandatory because the corporate seal is required for subsequent bank forms, road transport applications and customs declarations.
required_dossiers: Business license and unified social credit code certificate
Legal representative identity document and authorization letter
Seal engraving application form and filing record
Tax registration information form
Social insurance and payroll enrollment forms
Company Articles of Association
Registered office proof and lease agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is queried because of an incomplete address or legal representative identity, correct the matter immediately through the electronic tax bureau. If a seal engraving application is rejected or delayed, obtain a written reason and choose another authorized engraving enterprise. Tax registration must in all cases be completed within thirty days from the date of the business license to avoid penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank account opening, foreign exchange direct investment information registration and capital injection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A licensed commercial bank acting as a designated foreign exchange bank, and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange through the bank-delegated direct investment information registration system.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the RMB basic deposit account and the foreign currency capital account with a licensed bank after the business license and seals are available. Submit the first board resolution, bank signatory mandate, legal representative and financial officer identity documents, the Articles of Association and the beneficial ownership declaration form. The bank enters the direct investment information into the SAFE system and issues the capital account required for the foreign shareholder remittance. The foreign shareholder injects the subscribed registered capital by wire, the bank converts the foreign currency into RMB and credits the capital account, and the company obtains the capital contribution verification and foreign exchange registration record. These funds are then available for fleet acquisition, GPS sealing equipment, insurance and operating expenses after the sectoral licenses are obtained.
required_dossiers: Business license
Company seals and seal filing records
First board resolution and banking authorization
Legal representative and finance officer identity documents
Articles of Association
SAFE direct investment information registration form
Beneficial ownership and corporate structure declaration
Board resolution authorizing capital injection and bank accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or SAFE queries the shareholder structure or source of funds, submit a group structure chart, capital source explanation and apostilled corporate records. If the original bank refuses the account, apply to another licensed bank that accepts the compliance package. Any foreign exchange data correction must be completed within thirty days to avoid administrative penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Customs supervised vehicle fleet and road freight transport licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Administration of Customs and the local port customs supervision division; local Municipal Transport Commission or Highway Transport Administration; civil aviation airport cargo terminal authority where route access is required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Road Freight Transport Operation Permit from the local transport authority by filing the fleet inventory, vehicle ownership documents, driver vocational qualification certificates, vehicle compliance certificates, safety management system, parking site proof, registered capital and financial capacity evidence. After the transport permit is issued, register each truck with customs as a customs-supervised transport vehicle. Install GPS tracking and electronic or physical customs seals approved for bonded cargo, obtain the customs supervised vehicle logbook or electronic card, and enroll the bonded road feeder service route between the airport, bonded zone and port terminals in the GACC logistics supervision system. No bonded cargo may be carried before the customs route authorization and seal integrity protocol are active.
required_dossiers: Business license
Road Freight Transport Operation Permit application and safety system documents
Fleet registration certificates and vehicle inspection records
GPS and electronic seal installation certificates
Driver qualification and vocational training certificates
Congruent registered capital evidence and bank statements
Customs supervised transport vehicle registration application
EIA registration or exemption proof for supporting depot facilities
Fire safety and workplace safety certificates for offices and parking sites
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the transport authority questions the adequacy of registered capital or parking facilities, provide updated bank statements, lease contracts and a financial commitment letter from the foreign shareholder. If customs requires modifications to GPS hardware, seal integrity or data sharing protocols, complete the technical rectification and resubmit the terminal test report. If the application is suspended, obtain the written suspension reasons, cure the identified deficiencies and reapply within the administrative time limits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-licensing environmental, fire safety, occupational health and annual compliance clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau; Emergency Management Bureau; Fire and Rescue authority; housing and urban-rural development authority for structural inspections; local transport authority for annual road freight reporting.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the applicable construction fire-fighting design review, fire acceptance or fire-fighting record-filing for any office, dispatch center, parking depot or maintenance workshop constructed or renovated by the company. If the premises are leased and no construction is performed, obtain the landlord's fire safety acceptance certificate and conduct a fire compliance assessment under the Fire Protection Law of the People's Republic of China. Conduct the occupational health and work safety inspection required by the Work Safety Law, including road transport safety production standardization, emergency response plans, first aid equipment, driver training and vehicle maintenance records. File any required EIA registration form with the ecology bureau if the company constructs ancillary parking, office or maintenance areas. Finally, complete the annual enterprise information report, road transport integrity report and customs logistics supervision report before each anniversary of establishment.
required_dossiers: Fire protection acceptance or record-filing certificate for the premises
Landlord fire safety certificate for leased premises
Emergency response and road transport safety production plan
Occupational health and safety registration forms
Vehicle emission test reports demonstrating China VI compliance
Hazardous waste storage and removal contracts
EIA registration form or exemption statement
Annual road transport industry integrity and safety report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If fire acceptance fails, correct the structural, electrical or fire extinguishing deficiencies and re-inspect. If environmental registration is challenged, prepare the required EIA registration form or a baseline environmental assessment. If the road transport safety certificate is suspended, immediately stop operations and cure the noncompliance; continued operation after suspension is prohibited under the Work Safety Law and road transport regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China and the local Municipal Transport Commission; General Administration of Customs and its local port customs office; Civil Aviation Administration of China and airport cargo terminal authority; municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau and Emergency Management Bureau.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Road Freight Transport Operation Permit; Customs-Supervised Transportation Vehicle Registration; GPS-Sealed Bonded Cargo Truck Fleet Customs Operating Approval; Airport Cargo Terminal Road Feeder Access Permit.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China and the local Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for the pure mobile truck fleet operation where no construction is carried out. If the company constructs offices, parking depots, dispatch centers or maintenance workshops, the project falls under the Environment Registration Form tier of the MEE Classified Management List for Construction Projects, requiring a simple online registration rather than a full Environmental Impact Assessment Report. A Full EIA Report is not required for this business scope.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: All heavy-duty trucks must meet China VI emission limits: carbon monoxide no more than 1.5 grams per kilowatt-hour, total hydrocarbons no more than 0.13 grams per kilowatt-hour, nitrogen oxides no more than 0.40 grams per kilowatt-hour, and particulate matter no more than 0.01 grams per kilowatt-hour under the WHSC test cycle set out in GB 17691-2018. Depot sewage connected to municipal sewers must meet COD no more than 500 mg/L, BOD5 no more than 300 mg/L, suspended solids no more than 400 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen no more than 45 mg/L, and pH between 6 and 9, per GB/T 31962-2015. Waste mineral oil, oil filters and batteries are hazardous wastes and must be stored in a compliant temporary storage area and removed by licensed carriers under a hazardous waste transfer manifest; if diesel or oil storage tanks are installed, fugitive vapour and non-methane hydrocarbon emissions must comply with GB 37822-2019.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-fighting design review and fire acceptance or fire-fighting record-filing under the Fire Protection Law of the People's Republic of China must be completed for any office, dispatch center, parking depot and maintenance workshop. Where trucks park in a multi-storey structure, a structural load inspection and load-bearing certificate are mandatory. Occupational health and work safety approvals under the Work Safety Law, including road transport safety production standardization, emergency response plans, fire extinguishing equipment, evacuation signage, drivers' vocational qualification registration and vehicle maintenance safety protocols, are required before bonded road feeder operations commence.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, served locally through the competent district/city tax bureaus and the E-Tax online platform (the official electronic tax filing and invoice portal of the STA).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: After registration with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), the 18-digit Uniform Social Credit Code (USCC) on the Business License is the statutory taxpayer identification number for the WFOE. The WFOE must complete the tax registration supplement through the E-Tax platform with the competent local STA office within 30 days of business establishment, covering enterprise income tax, VAT, and withholding obligations. It must file its bank account details, legal representative/controller information, and tax accountant contact; register for VAT; and apply for general VAT taxpayer status once annual taxable turnover exceeds RMB 5,000,000 (or elect it earlier to preserve input VAT credits). Foreign investors must provide their home-country corporate registration/passport evidence and complete the SAFE foreign-investment registration through the receiving bank. Because the entity will operate a customs-bonded truck fleet, it must also complete China Customs registration for supervised/bonded transportation and obtain the electronic GPS seal and customs transit approvals before moving export cargo.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. PRC law has no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections; the only practical status election is between small-scale VAT taxpayer and general VAT taxpayer, and general status is mandatory at the RMB 5,000,000 turnover threshold and advisable for export-oriented WFOEs to access input VAT credits and possible zero-rating.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Every WFOE must carry a VAT identity; mandatory upgrade to general VAT taxpayer occurs when annual taxable turnover exceeds RMB 5,000,000. Below that threshold small-scale VAT treatment (simplified rate) may apply. For the bonded trucking scope, applicable VAT rates are 9% for road transportation services, 6% for auxiliary/logistics support, and 0% for qualifying cross-border/international transport services; goods remain at the 13% standard rate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: VAT invoices are governed by the STA national VAT invoice system. China uses digitalized e-invoices: the taxpayer issues through STA-approved invoicing software connected to the E-Tax platform, the invoice XML is transmitted in near real time to the STA e-invoice service platform, and the system assigns a national unique invoice number and digital fingerprint. Buyers verify invoices through the national invoice verification platform and the digital tax account. The bonded trucking WFOE must therefore maintain STA-compliant e-invoicing capability; VAT special invoices are required where the customer claims input credits, and export-related documentation must be supported by e-invoice records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The 0% VAT rate applies to exported goods that are legally declared to China Customs and actually leave China, and to qualifying cross-border taxable services supplied to overseas purchasers and consumed outside China. For the bonded road feeder service, zero-rating is substantiated only when the service forms part of an international transport chain, is performed under customs transit supervision, and is evidenced by a through air waybill/international consignment note or equivalent multimodal export document; revenue must be received from an overseas counterparty in foreign exchange. If the feeder movement is merely a domestic leg to an airport for a separate export contract, that domestic transport service remains taxable at 9% (or 6% for ancillary logistics support), and zero-rating cannot be claimed on the feeder service itself.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Customs Declaration) carrying the customs clearance electronic data
Master Air Waybill / Bill of Lading or International Road Consignment Note (CMR) covering the onward international carriage
Bonded customs transit seal record and GPS geo-location log for the sealed truck movement to the port/airport
Commercial invoice, packing list, and export sales/service contract identifying the overseas counterparty
Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) / bank foreign exchange collection receipt matching the declared export transaction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: STA, China Customs, and SAFE operate cross-matching audits of export declarations, e-invoice data, customs transit records, and foreign exchange receipts. If zero-rated export or cross-border service support is found fraudulent or unsubstantiated, the refund/output VAT exemption is clawed back with statutory late payment surcharge, a monetary penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax, and possible criminal liability for fraudulent tax-credit/export-rebate filing under Chinese law. The tax authority may retrospectively reassess beyond the ordinary limitation period where fraudulent intent is established.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange rate regime administered by the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) under the People's Bank of China. The Renminbi (RMB) is fully convertible on the current account for trade in goods, services, and profit remittances, subject to genuine transaction verification and the matching of customs declarations, invoices, and contracts. However, the capital account remains heavily regulated: inbound foreign direct investment into a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise requires FDI registration with SAFE through the bank and the opening of a capital account (foreign exchange settlement account) before any injection. Foreign currency received from the parent must be designated with a specific payment purpose code and cannot be used for purposes outside the approved business scope. While China no longer imposes mandatory forced surrender of export proceeds, all export foreign exchange receipts must be repatriated into China through designated banks and reconciled with the Trade Monitoring System; the enterprise may voluntarily convert to RMB or retain the foreign currency subject to its current account foreign exchange account ceiling. Dividend distributions to foreign shareholders are permitted after the annual statutory audit and corporate income tax final settlement; the remittance must be supported by an audit report, tax payment certificates, board resolution approving the distribution, and a SAFE-registered remittance application. Practically, profit extraction is separable from capital reduction or equity transfer, both of which require additional legal and tax procedures. Customs bonded trucking operators must also ensure that any duty-free or bonded-related cash flows are segregated and fully verifiable through the customs POD system.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Statutory timeline: export foreign exchange receipts must be repatriated into China within 180 days from the date of export clearance, unless an extension is approved by SAFE. Current law imposes no mandatory conversion ratio; 100% of proceeds must be repatriated through a designated forex bank and registered in the Trade Monitoring System, but the enterprise may voluntarily settle 0-100% into RMB or retain the foreign currency within the ceiling of its current account foreign exchange account. The retained foreign currency balance cannot exceed the verified annual operating revenue and trade-related receipts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Escrow Account (Capital Account) + RMB Basic Deposit Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Settlement Account (Current Account) + RMB General Operating Account
Customs Bonded Trade Settlement Account + Taxpayer Basic Account
Cross-Border Supply Chain Finance Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI platforms (e.g., Revolut Business, Airwallex, MultiPass) are not licensed banking institutions in China and cannot directly provide a WFOE with domestic RMB clearing through CNAPS or a local bank sort code. They are legally barred from acting as a primary account provider for a Chinese-domiciled entity with a valid business license; only banks holding a banking license from the National Financial Regulatory Administration (NFRA) and designated as a Forex Bank by SAFE may handle FX verification, capital settlement, and cross-border trade payment reconciliation. Certain fintechs operate through licensed China bank partners as payment gateways, but this does not remove the statutory KYC duty, SAFE registration obligation, or the requirement for a physical corporate bank relationship. The viability of using an offshore EMI as the main treasury rail is therefore very low and should be rejected for capital and operating accounts; at most, an EMI may support ancillary inbound remittance as a payment instruction service, but the final clearing must be executed via the domestic commercial banking system under the real-name account of the WFOE.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory legal representative of the WFOE, or a senior resident manager who has been validly appointed and authorised by the board, must appear physically in-branch at the selected domestic commercial bank for the corporate account opening interview. Remote consular proxy opening is not recognised as a full substitute; a non-resident director may be documented through a notarised and consular-legalised power of attorney, but at least one director or senior manager physically resident in mainland China must attend the onboarding session and submit original identification documents. The interview will be recorded and must cover the business model, source of funds, expected transaction volumes, customs bonded operations, and understanding of Chinese AML obligations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO resides in a high-risk tax haven with layered ownership; initial capital originates from a parent not directly tied to trucking operations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate register excerpt and certificate of incumbency from the parent's registered agent; notarised and apostilled passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners; a clear organisational chart with share percentages; signed capital contribution declaration from the parent board; source-of-wealth evidence from a recognised financial institution (bank statements and asset verification); and a written explanation of the parent's direct operational link to the bonded transport sector.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Customs bonded trucking involves high volumes of small-amount payments to independent drivers, fuel stations, and maintenance workshops, which may be viewed as potential smurfing or invoice splitting.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original transport contracts, customs cargo manifests, bonded warehouse receipts, and trip dispatch records; driver KYC files with commercial driving licences and employment or outsourcing agreements; fuel and toll electronic transaction logs with tax invoices; GPS route data from the sealed fleet to reconcile distances and fuel consumption; and an accounting trail showing that each outbound payment attaches to a verifiable trip and underlying transport order.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export proceeds in foreign currency are not matched to customs declarations due to time lags between truck arrival at the bonded airport and overseas client payment, creating a red flag for fake trade financing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export customs declaration records (Export Customs Declaration Form) with serial numbers and dates; airway bill or bonded trucking manifest; foreign exchange receipt confirmation from the designated bank; the trade contract with explicit terms of payment; and a reconciliation schedule in the SAFE Trade Monitoring System explaining settlement lags, including the expected collection period and any historical exceptions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of FDI capital funds for the purchase of trucks may be challenged as unauthorised investment outside the registered business scope, especially if sellers are overseas or located in free trade zones.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business license with registered scope covering customs transportation and road feeder services; vehicle purchase contracts and import LC documents or, for domestic procurement, tax invoices and vehicle registration certificates; a capital verification report issued by a licensed Chinese CPA confirming the capital usage; and a three-year business plan showing the fleet asset investment as part of the approved project and aligned with the customs bonded airport logistics requirements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The WFOE must complete FDI registration with SAFE through the chosen domestic bank under the Foreign Investment Information Reporting system, open an FDI capital account (foreign exchange settlement account), and receive the inbound remittance from the overseas parent company using SWIFT MT103 with an SAFE-designated FDI payment purpose code. After receipt, a licensed Chinese CPA must issue a capital verification report confirming the injection, after which funds can be converted into RMB only for payments within the approved business scope, truck procurement, rental deposits, insurance, and operational expenses. For single-investment amounts exceeding the macroprudential threshold, additional SAFE filing or approval may be triggered under the cross-border financing macroprudential adjustment rules, and the WFOE must ensure the negative list restrictions do not apply to its road feeder and customs bonded logistics activities.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements include SWIFT MT103 for documentary remittances related to spare parts, technology licensing fees, and overseas service charges; Commercial Letters of Credit (L/C) for imported vehicles, telematics equipment, and major fleet-related capital goods requiring supplier financing; and Documentary Collections (D/P and D/A) for trusted open-account transactions with established overseas logistics partners. Domestic RMB disbursements to fuel suppliers, toll authorities, maintenance workshops, and independent drivers should be executed via CNAPS ACH or the bank's enterprise internet banking platform, with every payment supported by a tax invoice, transport contract, or trip record to maintain a clear audit trail and comply with SAFE and tax bureau requirements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instructions: Bank-intermediated RMB FX forward contracts backed by genuine current account trade documents
Cross-currency swaps for trade financing of fleet imports under SAFE registration and macroprudential supervision
FX options and option combinations for hedging current account exposure with a real-demand underlying
Onshore NDFs are generally not permissible; offshore NDFs may be accessible but cannot be used for onshore hedge accounting or SAFE compliance
Currency swap agreements for foreign debt principal and interest hedges, subject to SAFE registration and bank credit approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Enterprise Annual Report on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (annual information disclosure required from all companies including WFOEs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System; data shared with the Ministry of Commerce for foreign-invested enterprise reporting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Each calendar year from 1 January through 30 June for data at 31 December of the preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Submission after 30 June triggers automatic inclusion in the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations; non-correction for three consecutive years results in inclusion in the List of Seriously Illegal and Untrustworthy Enterprises and disqualification of the legal representative or senior officer from serving as controller or director of another enterprise for three years; an administrative fine of up to RMB 10,000 may also be imposed under the 2024 revised Regulations on Enterprise Information Publicity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Annual Investment Information Report (annual foreign investment information filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) via the Integrated Foreign Investment Information Reporting System and SAMR National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 1 January through 30 June each year; any post-filing changes to investors, actual controller, shareholding, or main investment terms must be filed within 30 days of the change event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: MOFCOM will issue a 20-working-day correction order for omitted or inconsistent information; if the correction does not occur, the Foreign Investment Law (Articles 34 and 37) authorizes a fine of RMB 100,000 to RMB 500,000, plus possible abnormal-list credit restriction and disqualification consequences.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return and Settlement Declaration (annual enterprise income tax reconciliation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) local in-charge tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within five months after the close of each fiscal year, by 31 May of the following calendar year; quarterly provisional and prepayment returns are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Overdue tax accrues a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% of the overdue amount (about 18.25% per annum); late filing or non-filing attracts administrative fines ranging from RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000; understated or falsely declared tax obligations may attract penalties of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax, criminal prosecution for serious evasion, and tax-registration cancellation for missing or absent taxpayers.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements and Statutory Independent CPA Audit Report (annual corporate accounts)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Board of Directors and shareholders for approval; audited accounts retained for inspection by SAMR, STA and customs authorities and attached to the annual corporate income tax filing where required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Before the annual corporate income tax settlement deadline of 31 May; the audit must cover the fiscal year ended 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to have a legally mandated statutory audit does not create a separate SAMR fine, but audited financial statements are required for accurate annual report and tax filings; false audit reports expose the directors and the engaged CPA firm to liability, fines, licence suspension of the accounting firm, and disqualification; the absence of audited accounts can be treated as a credit and market-standing failure and, for a bonded customs logistics entity, may trigger suspension or revocation of the customs supervision licence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Customs Supervision Transport Vehicle Registration Certificate Annual Verification and Bonded Fleet Licence Maintenance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Administration of Customs (GACC) local customs office having competency over the bonded transport operator
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary expiration of each vehicle registration certificate; changes to vehicle plate, GPS and seal equipment, container capacity, or registered owner must be reported to customs within 30 days of the change; the operator must also keep customs fleet status updates current on the anniversary of the customs transport enterprise registration certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain current customs registration for any truck removes that vehicle from the customs supervision fleet and makes the vehicle ineligible to carry bonded or customs-supervised cargo; continued operation without valid registration is punishable under the Customs Administrative Punishment Regulations by forfeiture, penalty, suspension of customs surveillance privileges, and revocation of the bonded-fleet licence; the customs performance bond may be drawn if the operator breaches customs control conditions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Road Transport Business License Annual Status Verification and Road Transport Vehicle Annual Verification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial and municipal road transport administration under the Ministry of Transport
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Vehicle verifications are due on the anniversary of each vehicle road transport certificate issuance; operator-level licence information changes are filed within 20 working days; annual road-freight data returns follow the provincial transport authority published annual window, commonly 1 January to 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A road transport vehicle that fails annual verification is prohibited from operating as a for-hire commercial vehicle; continued operation attracts traffic-administrative violations, fines, vehicle detention, and possible revocation or administrative forfeiture of the road transport business licence after repeated non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Actual Controller and Beneficial Owner Confirmation in the Enterprise Annual Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SAMR and MOFCOM through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Embedded in the enterprise annual report due between 1 January and 30 June; ownership changes that affect UBO status or shareholding percentages must be reported to SAMR and MOFCOM within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or omitted actual controller and beneficial owner data may be treated as a false annual report or foreign investment information misdeclaration, triggering the Foreign Investment Law fines of RMB 100,000 to RMB 500,000, SAMR abnormal listing, and restriction on the legal representative service on other boards until corrected.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the PRC Company Law, every limited liability company, including a WFOE, must prepare annual financial statements and have them audited by an independent licensed certified public accountant; there is no turnover, balance-sheet, or headcount exemption for an ordinary WFOE. Quantitative triggers apply in addition for special categories only: publicly offered and listed companies are subject to China Securities Law audit reporting; licensed financial institutions, insurers, securities firms, and fund managers are subject to regulatory audit; customs AEO certification for a bonded operator requires current audited annual financial statements; and bank credit approval or tax-loss claims may require an audit as a practical condition. The WFOE in this payload must obtain a statutory audit regardless of revenue, asset size, or headcount.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (Chinese GAAP / CAS), which are substantially converged with IFRS; a WFOE may not use pure IFRS standalone for statutory filing unless expressly permitted; small-scale enterprises may apply the PRC Small Enterprises Accounting Standards only when eligible under the Ministry of Finance rules, but a customs-bonded transport WFOE normally applies full CAS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: China does not operate a separate annual UBO filing for ordinary WFOEs; instead, the Annual Enterprise Report annexed to the Foreign Investment Information Report requires each WFOE to confirm the actual controller and beneficial owner, the ultimate holding structure, and shareholding percentages. Material changes to shareholding, actual controller, control rights, or main investment terms are reportable to SAMR and MOFCOM within 30 days of the event. The statutory registers of members and pledges must be updated when the equity transfer or pledge is completed; the registers are subject to inspection by SAMR during random information-supervision checks under the double random, one public system.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Share Pledges and Equity Charges
Minute Book of Shareholders Meetings and Board Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 - USD 1,500 for a registered address or office support service; USD 1,200 - USD 3,000 for a professional corporate secretarial and compliance-agent retainer in Beijing, Shanghai, or Guangzhou
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 4,500 for a typical small or mid-size WFOE audited under PRC GAAP; the fee can rise to USD 6,000 - USD 12,000 for a bonded truck fleet requiring consolidated group reporting, customs schedules, and AEO support

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard PRC corporate income tax rate is 25%. Qualifying small and low-profit enterprises may benefit from a 20% preferential rate with phased effective rates on prescribed taxable-income brackets; qualified High and New Technology Enterprises pay 15%; eligible R&D costs may be deducted at 100% additional deduction; general tax loss carryforward is 5 years, extended to 10 years for qualifying high-tech and small low-profit enterprises.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (Form A) and quarterly provisional returns; filed through the State Taxation Administration e-Tax portal (etax.chinatax.gov.cn)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement and quarterly provisional prepayment returns
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly prepayment returns are due within 15 days after the end of each quarter; annual final return and self-assessment are due by May 31 of the following calendar year (5 months after fiscal year-end)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Entity Identification and Fiscal Period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Records legal name, unified social credit code, registered address, tax residency status, fiscal year start and end dates, bookkeeping currency, and applicable accounting standard.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter Resident Enterprise for the Chinese WFOE. Non-resident shareholders are not shown in this box; they are disclosed in related-party schedules and in withholding tax returns on any actual remittance of dividends, interest, or royalties. Ensure the fiscal year end matches the customs bonded operating license and the consolidated statutory accounts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Principal Activity, ISIC Code and License Endorsements
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Records principal business activity code corresponding to ISIC 5222 / NAICS 484121, customs bonded road feeder transport license, GPS seal system registration and tax classification of transport services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose cross-border transportation receipts separately. If a non-resident affiliate is engaged for dispatch, GPS tracking or seal monitoring, the service fee may be a Chinese-source service charge subject to withholding tax unless a permanent establishment or Treaty protection is established. Register the non-resident with an observer number and track deemed profit under deemed-profit rules if no actual accounting.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of profit per financial statements: operating revenue, operating costs, fuel, tolls, driver wages, GPS maintenance, customs supervision fees, insurance, depreciation, other operating expenses, and administrative expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the WFOE operating bonded feeder trucking, accrue revenue when the customs-bonded movement is completed and gate-in at the airport occurs. If revenue is partly earned outside mainland China because the destination is an overseas customs port, apply the business profits article of the relevant DTA and allocate no more than the profit attributable to a China permanent establishment; document the allocation method.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconciliation between accounting profit and taxable income; add-back of non-deductible expenses (e.g., excessive entertainment, related-party interest exceeding thin capitalization, taxes and penalties), and deduction of exempt income, accelerated depreciation, and special tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include arm's-length adjustments for any related-party trucking fees paid to non-resident group companies. Reject deductions lacking invoices from GPS, customs, or fuel vendors. If interest is paid to a non-resident, apply the thin capitalization ratio (2:1 debt-to-equity for non-financial enterprises) and the acceptable interest rate; excess interest is disallowed and may be recharacterized as dividend.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Loss Carryforward and Tax Incentives
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply prior-year unrelieved tax losses, preferential tax rates, tax exemptions, reduced rates, additional deductions, and foreign tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only the Chinese WFOE's own current-year taxable income may absorb its carried-forward losses; losses cannot be surrendered by or attributed to the non-resident parent. A pure transport enterprise cannot use a patent box unless it holds qualifying IP. If claiming the small low-profit rate, verify the employee headcount and total assets thresholds; the non-resident parent's foreign jurisdiction status does not affect this.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Non-Resident Payments and Withholding Tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Discloses gross payments made to non-resident persons for dividends, interest, royalties, service fees, and equipment rentals, with statutory withholding tax rate, reduced DTA rate and proof documents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For outbound dividends, the statutory WHT is 10% unless a reduction to 5% (Mainland-Hong Kong/Macau arrangements with at least 25% shareholding) or another DTA applies. Attach the non-resident's Tax Residency Certificate, beneficial ownership declaration, and a statement that the shareholder is not a conduit. Withhold at the treaty-claimable rate only after the withholding agent obtains the completed treaty benefit forms; otherwise withhold at statutory rate and allow a refund claim.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Tax Credits, Prepayments and Balance Due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Summarizes quarterly installment payments already made, foreign income tax credits, and final balance of tax payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the WFOE's foreign feeder operations create a foreign permanent establishment, compute foreign-source income and claim a foreign tax credit under Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 23. Do not credit taxes withheld on dividends paid to the non-resident shareholder; those are shareholder-level taxes and cannot be refunded to the WFOE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 - Declaration, Authentication and Filing Representation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal representative certification, seal, date, tax agent information, and declaration that all information and schedules are true and complete.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The legal representative of the WFOE signs under criminal liability for false declarations. Any misrepresentation in the treaty benefits schedule or customs bonded cargo count may trigger both administrative fraud penalties and personal criminal prosecution. Retain all transfer pricing and beneficial ownership documentation for at least 10 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of RMB 2,000, increasing to RMB 2,000-10,000 for serious cases under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 62; overdue tax accrues daily interest at 0.05% under Article 32; under-declaration or fraudulent filing is subject to a penalty of 50% to 5x the underpaid tax under Article 63; criminal tax evasion may be prosecuted under PRC Criminal Law Article 201 if the amount evaded is RMB 50,000 or more and exceeds 10% of the tax due.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory, reduced to 5% under Mainland-Hong Kong/Macau tax arrangements for a non-resident enterprise that has held at least 25% of the WFOE capital for the 12 months immediately preceding dividend receipt; other DTAs may provide 5-10%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate from its home jurisdiction, execute a beneficial ownership declaration confirming it has the economic substance to receive and control the dividend, and produce the certificate and declaration to the Chinese withholding agent before the remittance date. The withholding agent must file the withholding tax return and treaty benefit forms on the e-Tax portal, list the reduced withholding rate, and retain the TRC, audited accounts, shareholding history, and substance evidence. If the WFOE has already withheld at the statutory 10%, the non-resident may file a refund application within three years under the tax collection rules, with the STA verifying beneficial ownership and absence of treaty abuse.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding on outbound royalties and interest is 10%. DTA reductions commonly provide 5% or 7% for royalties paid to a beneficial owner under an income tax convention and 5-10% for interest, subject to an approved fair interest rate and anti-abuse clauses. The withholding agent must submit the non-resident's TRC and agreement before applying the reduced rate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is required when annual related-party tangible-property transfers exceed RMB 200 million, financial asset transfers exceed RMB 100 million, intangible property transfers exceed RMB 100 million, or other related-party transactions in aggregate exceed RMB 40 million; Master File is required when annual cross-border related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion; Country-by-Country Report threshold is RMB 5.5 billion consolidated group revenue.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Mainland China does not apply the Gulf Cooperation Council ESR/CIGA framework, but the Economic Substance doctrine under the State Taxation Administration rules and General Anti-Avoidance Rule (EITL Article 47) prevents treaty and tax-rate shopping. A trucking WFOE should demonstrate CIGA-style substance: locally employed drivers, dispatch and maintenance teams, GPS-monitored customs seals under WFOE control, vehicle ownership or multi-year leases, invoices and contracts, board meeting records, and risk-management decision-making. Lack of substance may cause the tax authority to deny treaty benefits, recharacterize royalty/dividend payments, and impose penalties and interest.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / False VAT Invoicing in Bonded Trucking Operations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing or obtaining forged special VAT invoices for GPS-monitored customs-bonded trucking movements that were never performed, inflating deductible costs, understating corporate income tax, and claiming VAT export rebates or input credits on phantom cross-border feeder services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under PRC Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63, the taxpayer must pay the underpaid tax and interest plus a penalty from 50% to 5 times the amount underpaid. Under PRC Criminal Law Article 205, issuing false VAT invoices is punishable by imprisonment up to life and confiscation of property.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil under PRC Company Law Article 20 and Civil Code Article 83 where the director abused the separate personality of the WFOE to evade tax and defraud customs. The director is jointly and severally liable for restoration of corporate assets; may be placed on the tax dishonesty blacklist with exit-restriction and disqualification; and if personally involved, may face criminal imprisonment of up to 15 years or life for VAT fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Treaty Abuse and Beneficial Ownership Failure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the WFOE as a conduit with no real staff, premises, vehicle fleet, GPS seals, board decisions or risk exposure, while routing the non-resident shareholder's dividends, interest or royalties through mainland China to obtain a DTA-reduced withholding rate or to shift logistics income to a tax-haven affiliate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 47 empowers the STA to make special tax adjustment under GAAR and recharacterize the arrangement; SAT Public Notice 2018 No. 9 denies treaty benefits if the claimant is not the beneficial owner. Sanctions include repayment of under-withheld tax, daily 0.05% interest, and penalties of 50% to 5x underpaid tax under Article 63 of the Tax Collection Administration Law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: If the director signs treaty-benefit declarations knowing the WFOE has no economic substance, he or she is exposed to personal restitution for the diverted withholding tax, being named in the major tax violation blacklist, a travel ban under Exit-Entry Administration Law Article 12, and criminal prosecution for tax evasion under Criminal Law Article 201 with imprisonment of up to 7 years for substantial underpaid tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Customs Bonded Vehicle Violation / Smuggling Through Feeder Falsification
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Tampering with GPS anti-tamper seals, breaking customs surveillance locks, substituting cargo, abandoning bonded loads at non-customs locations, or falsifying transit manifest data of the bonded truck fleet to evade customs duties, value-added tax and import restrictions on the airport feeder route.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Customs Law Article 82 requires confiscation of smuggled goods, transport equipment and proceeds and imposes fines of up to 3 times the evaded duties; Criminal Law Article 153 imposes fixed-term imprisonment (up to life for large or aggravated smuggling).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who organizes or allows GPS tampering can be prosecuted as a smuggler, with corporate veil piercing to recover unpaid customs duties from personal assets; customs authorities may revoke the bonded transport license, blacklist and ban the director from undertaking customs affairs, and impose imprisonment of 3 to 10 years (or life where the evaded duty and product category are aggravating).
